tasks.topic_en: Polynomial as a square of a polynomial
tasks.statement_en: The polynomial $W(x) = x^4+ax^3+bx^2-24x+9$ is the square of the polynomial $P(x)=x^2+cx+d$. Compute a and b.
tasks.notes: two valid solution pairs: (a,b)=(-8,22) [from c=-4,d=3] or (8,10) [from c=4,d=-3]; sum of all four numbers = 32 [verified: exclude: Two valid solution pairs (c,d)=(-4,3)/(4,-3) give (a,b)=(-8,22) or (8,10); solver may sum one pair (14/18) or all (32) - several solution sets.]

tasks.statement_en: The angle $\alpha$ is such that $\cos\alpha + \sin\alpha = \frac{4}{3}$. Compute the value of the expression $|\cos\alpha - \sin\alpha|$.
Determine all values of the parameter m for which the equation $2x^2+(3-2m)x-m+1=0$ has two distinct roots $x_1, x_2$ such that $|x_1-x_2|=3$.
tasks.notes: sum of the two valid m values: 7/2 + (-5/2) = 1 [verified: ok: Delta=(2m-1)^2, |x1-x2|=|2m-1|/2=3 -> m=7/2 or -5/2 (both != 1/2); sum 1 matches key.]
